test_game_from_cc: test the python kuhn poker game by loading it via pyspiel and running random simulations
test_consistent: test that python and c++ kuhn poker game implementations produce identical states and observations
test_nash_value_sequence_form_lp: test the nash equilibrium values of kuhn poker using the sequence form linear programming solver
test_exploitability_uniform_random_py: test the exploitability of a uniform random policy against kuhn poker using the python exploitability function
test_cfr_cc: test running the counterfactual regret minimization solver on kuhn poker via pyspiel
